description: Get top vendors by expense spending. Returns a UNIFIED vendor list where every entry has an explicit "currency" field, a "comparable" flag (true = primary currency, false = foreign), and "converted_to_primary" field. converted_to_primary is null when no conversion data exists, or { amount, currency, invoices_converted, invoices_total, source } when bank reconciliation has recorded actual settlement amounts. Includes a top-level "currency_warning". Amounts in different currencies are NOT comparable or summable. For calendar-year periods, date_from is YYYY-01-01 and date_to is YYYY-12-31. Requires the Start or Business plan.

date_from.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). For year queries use YYYY-01-01

date_to.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD). For year queries use YYYY-12-31

limit.description: Number of top vendors to return (default: 10)

name: get_top_vendors
